7 Brew Lemonade: Price, Calories & Caffeine

A medium Lemonade is about $3.50, with 200 calories, 0 mg of caffeine and 49 g of sugar. Every number here comes from 7 Brew's own published nutrition guide, broken out by size and preparation.

Lemonade allergens

7 Brew's published allergen guide lists no declared allergens for the standard Lemonade. Adding a milk, syrup or topping changes this, and every drink is made on shared equipment, so cross-contact is possible.

If you are ordering around an allergy, check the full allergen and dietary guide and confirm at the window.

How to order a Lemonade

Ask for it by name — it is on the standard board at every 7 Brew, so no special script is needed. Say the size first, then the drink: "Can I get a medium Lemonade?"

Worth knowing before you order: the base is customisable. You can swap milk, ask for sugar-free syrups, change the sweetness level, or have most drinks made iced, hot or blended as a frozen chiller where the menu allows. Ordering through the app earns 100 rewards points either way.

A Lemonade Like 7 Brew's, at Home

The stand uses a concentrate. At home you can go either way: a good lemonade concentrate from the store gets you closest to the drive-thru cup, and fresh lemons get you something a little brighter. Both are honest versions of the same drink.

For about 4 cups

  • 3/4 cup lemon juice (fresh, or reconstituted concentrate)
  • 1/2 cup sugar, dissolved in 1 cup warm water
  • 2 1/2 cups cold water
  • Plenty of ice
  1. Stir the sugar water and lemon juice together first, so nothing gritty survives.
  2. Add the cold water, taste, and adjust. 7 Brew's leans sweet-tart, not shy.
  3. Pour over a full glass of ice. That part is not optional.

The math: a medium at the stand runs about 49 g of sugar in 24 oz. This batch lands in that neighborhood per big glass, which is why it tastes right. Flavor it like the menu: a spoon of fruit syrup per glass turns it into any combo on the board.

7 Brew Lemonade FAQ

How many calories are in a 7 Brew Lemonade?

A medium iced Lemonade has 200 calories. A small has 140 and a large 270, according to 7 Brew's nutrition guide.

How much caffeine is in a 7 Brew Lemonade?

0 mg. Lemonade is caffeine free, unless you mix it with tea.

How much does a 7 Brew Lemonade cost?

Roughly $2.75 for a small, $3.50 for a medium and $4.25 for a large. Prices are our estimates and vary by stand — every 7 Brew is independently owned.

How much sugar is in a 7 Brew Lemonade?

49 g in a medium.

What does 7 Brew actually use for its lemonade?

A lemon concentrate mixed with water. 7 Brew never claims fresh-squeezed anywhere on its menu, and Lemon Concentrate is literally listed as an ingredient inside official builds like the Key Lime Pie Lemonade. One fan site describes the drinks as real lemon juice made fresh to order. That sounds nicer. It is not what 7 Brew publishes. Concentrate is also why the flavor stays identical at every stand, which fresh lemons would never manage.

Why does a frozen lemonade chiller have three times the calories?

Because it is not the iced drink blended. A medium iced lemonade is 200 calories and 49 g of sugar. The same lemonade as a Frozen Chiller is 630 calories and 151 g of sugar. The chiller is a frozen drink built on a much heavier, sweeter base, closer to a slushie dessert than to lemonade over ice. Neither number is a typo. If you are ordering the chiller thinking it is the light option with a different texture, the table above is worth a second look.

How do you order an Arnold Palmer at 7 Brew?

Ask for half lemonade, half tea. It is not printed on the official menu for lemonades or for teas, so the name alone can get you a blank look at some stands. Half lemonade, half black tea is the classic; half lemonade, half green tea is the popular twist, and the Fruit Roll-Up Green Tea Lemonade is basically that idea with strawberry and lavender in it. One warning: the tea half brings caffeine with it. An Arnold Palmer is not a caffeine-free drink, even though the lemonade half is.

Can you get a sugar-free lemonade at 7 Brew?

Not a plain one, and the reason is the base. The lemonade itself is sweetened, so swapping syrups cannot make it sugar-free. The guide's only sugar-free lemonade entry is the Sugar-Free Cocoberry Lemonade, and even that carries 190 calories and 45 g of sugar in a medium, because the sugar-free part is the flavoring, not the lemonade under it. 7 Brew says the same thing in its own fine print: a drink with sugar-free flavors may not be sugar-free overall. Anyone promising you a zero-sugar 7 Brew lemonade is selling something the guide does not list. Our sugar-free page tracks which drinks truly hit zero.

Can 7 Brew make a strawberry lemonade?

Yes, just not as a named menu card. There is no Strawberry Lemonade on the official grid of 10. You order it as lemonade plus strawberry syrup, a build-your-own, and stands make them all day. If you want strawberry with a twist already worked out, the Fruit Roll-Up Lemonade is strawberry and lavender on the same base, and it is one of the best-known drinks on the lemonade menu.
